ProfessionalCsvDAO

class ProfessionalCsvDAO(institution_dao=None)[source]

Bases: DAO[Professional]

DAO for Professional entities, one CSV file per record.

Persists each professional in its own CSV file named after its ID and sanitized name, and keeps all professionals in an in-memory cache loaded when the DAO is created.

Parameters:
institution_daoInstitutionFacilityCsvDAO | None, optional

DAO used to resolve the institution of each professional. Default is None, which creates a new InstitutionFacilityCsvDAO (with its own cache).

Attributes:
csv_handlerCSVHandler

Utility for reading and writing CSV data.

professionalsdict[int, Professional]

In-memory cache by ID.

file_mapdict[int, str]

CSV file path by ID.

int_propertieslist[str]

Names of the Professional fields typed int.

bool_propertieslist[str]

Names of the Professional fields typed bool.

institution_daoInstitutionFacilityCsvDAO

DAO used to resolve institutions.

Notes

Files are named <id>_<sanitized name>_professional.csv and stored in the professional directory of PathConfig.

The institutionfacility column holds the facility ID. When loading, it is resolved with institution_dao.select; an empty, non-numeric or unknown ID gives None, and such a professional is not valid until a facility is set.

generate_next_id()[source]

Return the next available professional ID.

Returns:
int

The highest cached ID plus 1, or 1 if the cache is empty.

write_with_lock(filepath, data, headers)[source]

Write rows to a CSV file while holding an exclusive lock.

Parameters:
filepathstr

Full path to the target CSV file.

datalist[dict]

Rows to write, one dictionary per row.

headerslist[str]

Ordered column names; a header row is written first.

Raises:
portalocker.exceptions.LockException

If the lock cannot be acquired within 10 seconds.

Notes

The user directories are created if needed. The file is opened by portalocker.Lock in mode "w" with Python’s defaults, so it uses the platform’s default encoding and newline translation, unlike CSVHandler.write_csv with a path (UTF-8 with BOM).

load_all_professionals()[source]

Load every professional CSV file into the cache.

Notes

Reads each *_professional.csv file of the professional directory; empty or unreadable files are skipped. Only the first row is used. Integer fields that are not plain digits (including negative numbers) become 0, and boolean fields are True only for "true" (any case).
